headline: Healthcare and Cables lead broad-based momentum as expansion breadth stays dominant across Indian equities.
breadth_commentary: Overall market health remains constructive with 986 issues in expansion versus 625 in drawdown across the broader tracking universe. Sector displacement breadth is led by Health Care (18.4% bullish expansion vs 6.5% bearish) and Consumer Discretionary (17.3% bullish vs 3.4% bearish), while Power Sector lags with net negative expansion (5.2% bullish vs 7.8% bearish). Across the 395-stock active universe, high-conviction pockets continue to exhibit strong upside displacement over downside breaks.
sector_leadership: Health Care is asserting broad domain leadership, with Export Pharma (conviction 87.4, RRG score 93.8) and Balanced Pharma (conviction 73.3, RRG score 85.0) both hitting 52-week highs. Infrastructure's Cables - Electricals segment is also demonstrating premier relative strength, boasting a top RRG score of 97.5 alongside a 13.41% 4-week momentum gain. Additionally, niche themes such as Gems, Jewellery And Watches (75.14 conviction) and Midcap Private Banks (73.38 conviction) are showing strong momentum and expansion characteristics.
sector_laggards: Laggards are heavily concentrated in Microfinance Institutions (-13.94% 4-week momentum), Water & Waste Management (-13.31%), and Housing Finance Co (-9.67%), all holding bottom-tier RRG scores. Cement Products and Ceramics also show persistent weakness with negative 4-week returns exceeding -6.5%.
notable_setups: Top PM focus explosive candidates include export pharma names RUBICON.NS (0.837 score) and NEULANDLAB.NS (0.835 score), alongside power equipment play INDOTECH.NS (0.78 score). In the drawdown-recovery scanner, 'New Campaign' leaders showing tight drawdowns and sustained weeks above prior highs include THELEELA.NS (3.77% DD, 10 weeks above DDH) and TEXINFRA.NS (5.81% DD, 9 weeks above DDH). Strong upside displacement z-scores are also visible in RBA.NS (4.40) and MOREPENLAB.NS (4.04).
levels_to_watch: Key 52-week ceiling structural breakouts were confirmed in TI.NS (z-score 3.84) and FINCABLES.NS (z-score 2.57). Conversely, downside 52-week floor structural breaks require caution in INDIASHLTR.NS, KPGEL.BO, JKLAKSHMI.NS, and AWHCL.NS.
